note: G37: filtered-MRR evaluation for variable-length rule bodies

controls.name: C1_general_walk_reproduces_the_specialised_one
controls.must_fire_because: a generalisation that changes the numbers is a different instrument
controls.can_fail_because: dropping the distinct-node guard, or scoring an endpoint reached by two paths twice, would both raise MRR while looking like a successful generalisation
controls.null_must_contain: any metric differing from yardstick.py on identical 2-hop rules

controls.name: C2_planted_len3_found_by_general_missed_by_twohop
controls.must_fire_because: the generalisation must buy something structural, not just parse
controls.can_fail_because: if the 2-hop walk also solved it, the extra length would be decorative
controls.null_must_contain: the 2-hop walk scoring a length-3 rule as well as the general walk

observations.twohop_error: ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 2, got 3)

controls.name: C3_planted_len1_found_by_general_missed_by_twohop
controls.must_fire_because: length-1 is the class G34 measured as carrying most of the lift
controls.can_fail_because: a body of length 1 would unpack under the 2-hop destructure only if the guard were absent
controls.null_must_contain: the 2-hop walk scoring a length-1 rule

observations.twohop_error: ValueError: not enough values to unpack (expected 2, got 1)

falsifiers.name: F1_instrument_drift
falsifiers.can_fail_because: any of MRR/Hits@1/Hits@3/Hits@10 differs from yardstick.py on the same 2-hop rules, or from G30's published row at 4 dp
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an exact match on all four metrics
falsifiers.refutes: WITHDRAW the evaluator if it does not reproduce G30 exactly
falsifiers.fires_when: any of MRR/Hits@1/Hits@3/Hits@10 differs from yardstick.py on the same 2-hop rules, or from G30's published row at 4 dp
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: The generalised walk differs from yardstick.py on identical 2-hop rules, or finds nothing the 2-hop walk misses
